name: be-vat-return
description: Preparing and filing the Belgian periodic VAT return (periodieke btw-aangifte / déclaration périodique TVA) for tax year 2026: who files, the 21%, 12%, 6% and 0% rates (hotels and campsites 12% from 1 March 2026), monthly or quarterly filing (EUR 2,500,000 test, EUR 50,000 intra-EU test), the 20th and 25th deadlines and the 2026 calendar, Intervat, which grid each transaction goes in, domestic reverse charge for construction (KB nr. 1 art. 20) and other customer-pays cases, the annual client listing (over EUR 250 per customer, before 31 March) and the intra-EU listing, structured B2B e-invoicing from 1 January 2026 and its fines, the small-business exemption at EUR 25,000 with its 10% tolerance and the rises to EUR 26,000-30,000 from 2027, the EU small-business scheme (EUR 100,000), refunds and the VAT provision account, capital goods, late interest of 8% for 2026 and the fines in KB nr. 41 and 44. Trigger on: Belgian VAT return, btw-aangifte invullen, rooster 71, Intervat, klantenlist
